eps.ov: While Legoshi adjusts to a new life outside Cherryton, the school announces a new segregation policy. The current BEASTAR takes an interest in Legoshi.

eps.t: The Shiny Black Nose Before Me
eps.ov: Legoshi's meat withdrawal causes trouble with his new neighbor. The Shishi-Gumi's enigmatic new leader plans to distribute a dangerous energy drink.
Recalling Louis's words, Legoshi beats up the energy drink pushers. As the drama club makes a tough decision, the wolf finds a familiar face waiting.

eps.t: The Gravity of Being a Land Dweller
eps.ov: Gosha shocks his grandson with his fighting prowess. Yahya remembers his history with Gosha. Later, a kind seal teaches Legoshi about the marine world.
After catching up with his old drama club friends, Legoshi meets with Yahya. Meanwhile, a cunning civet forces the Shishi-Gumi to work with him.
As Legoshi recovers under Gohin's care, Yahya investigates Melon, a gazelle therapist. Haru reaches a sobering conclusion on interspecies relationships.
On a birthday date, Legoshi confesses everything to Haru. Determined to take their relationship seriously, she makes a daring and dangerous request.

eps.t: What Lies at the End of the Melon Patch
eps.ov: While the Black Market is abuzz with shocking rumors, Yahya makes plans to catch Melon. The 500 Cornered Rats continue their underground surveillance.
The drama club members chafe against the interspecies restrictions. Enticed by Yahya's promise, Legoshi infiltrates Melon's underground party.
Louis's investigations into the spiked energy drink take him back to the Black Market, where he runs into his old comrades — and their new leader.
Eager to learn more about the effects of Kines, Louis goes undercover and meets Deshico. Legoshi continues his investigation into Melon alone.
Unable to get a meeting with Yahya, Louis sneaks in. Meanwhile, Legoshi follows the clues from the tattoo parlor. Will he be able to find Melon?
